name: Benchmark v2 (SWE‑Lancer)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      exercise:
        description: "Task ID (e.g., 16912_4)"
        required: true
      agent:
        description: "Agent name"
        required: false
      provider:
        description: "Provider name"
        required: false
      model:
        description: "Model name"
        required: false
      timeout_seconds:
        description: "Timeout in seconds (default 3600)"
        required: false
        default: "3600"
      v2_setup_wait_seconds:
        description: "Wait seconds after setup (default 900)"
        required: false
        default: "900"

concurrency:
  group: "benchmark-v2-${{ github.repository }}"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  run-benchmark:
    name: Run v2 benchmark
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    env:
      TS_BENCH_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TS_BENCH_API_KEY }}
      TS_BENCH_API_SECRET: ${{ secrets.TS_BENCH_API_SECRET }}
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      EXERCISE: ${{ inputs.exercise }}
      AGENT: ${{ inputs.agent }}
      PROVIDER: ${{ inputs.provider }}
      MODEL: ${{ inputs.model }}
      TIMEOUT_SECONDS: ${{ inputs.timeout_seconds }}
      V2_SETUP_WAIT_SECONDS: ${{ inputs.v2_setup_wait_seconds }}

    steps:
      - name: Clean up disk space
        run: |
          sudo rm -rf /var/lib/docker/overlay2/*
          sudo rm -rf /var/lib/docker/overlay2/*
          sudo rm -rf /var/lib/docker/overlay2/*
          sudo rm -rf /var/lib/docker/overlay2/*

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          lfs: true
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Create .patches directory
        run: mkdir -p .patches

      - name: Install Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Pull Docker image
        run: docker pull swelancer/swelancer_x86_monolith:releasev1

      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          bun src/index.ts \
            --dataset v2 \
            --docker \
            --exercise "$EXERCISE" \
            --agent "$AGENT" \
            --provider "$PROVIDER" \
            --model "$MODEL" \
            --timeout_seconds "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" \
            --v2_setup_wait_seconds "$V2_SETUP_WAIT_SECONDS"

      - name: Upload benchmark artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-results
          path: |
            data/results/
            results/
            logs/
            benchmark-summary.txt
            .patches/
